context: Ongoing: Six-axis sensor drifts with temperature and bolt preload. This week: Hana suspects mounting plate flatness; sensor wants 0.01 mm, plate is spec 0.05.
Ongoing: Capacitive tactile array crosstalk and flex cable routing through the finger
Ongoing: Crossed-roller preload drops after thermal cycling; bore tolerance and preload ring design
Ongoing: Drop from 30 cm cracks the shank link at the knee clevis. This week: Diego: fillet R0.5 is too tight, peak stress ~380 MPa in FEA, 7075 fatigue limit is lower.
Ongoing: Replace foot switches with a learned contact estimate from joint currents. This week: Estimator hits 96% on logged data; misses at slow heel strikes.
